row.team_price_text: Publisher: $29/mo billed yearly (3 staff users, 1,000 members)
row.evidence: Ghost(Pro) plans differ by staff-user count (3 on Publisher, 15 on Business, unlimited on Custom) with no SSO or SCIM listed, and staff log in to Ghost Admin with device verification and email 2FA.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Ghost(Pro) is priced per site by member count, not per user: Starter $18/mo (1 staff user), Publisher $29/mo (3), Business $199/mo (15), Custom (unlimited), billed yearly at 1,000 members. No SAML/OIDC SSO and no SCIM on any plan, found by absence across the pricing page, docs index, help centre and changelog. The Admin API (Publisher and up) can list, update and delete staff users, fetch roles and send invites; integration keys are read-only for users.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Flat site price at the 1,000-member slider default; rises with member count. Monthly billing also offered. Single staff user, so not a team plan. No SSO or SCIM appears on the pricing page or in the docs; sso/scim false by absence.

plans.name: Publisher
plans.notes: Flat site price at the 1,000-member slider default; rises with member count. Monthly billing also offered. No SSO or SCIM appears on the pricing page or in the docs; sso/scim false by absence.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Flat site price at the 1,000-member slider default; rises with member count. Monthly billing also offered. No SSO or SCIM appears on the pricing page or in the docs; sso/scim false by absence.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: No SSO or SCIM appears on the pricing page or in the docs; sso/scim false by absence.

scim.notes: No SCIM or SSO in the pricing comparison, the docs index (docs.ghost.org/llms.txt), the help-centre sitemap or the changelog sitemap. Staff are invited by email and sign in with password plus email 2FA. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Integration Admin API key signs short-lived JWTs; staff access tokens act with the staff user's role. Integrations can only browse/read users; editing, deleting and inviting staff need user (staff token) auth with an Admin/Owner role.

capabilities.notes: Staff are added by invite with a role ID; no direct create. Role changes go through user update (roles field). Suspension exists in the admin UI but no API call for it is documented. Ghost has no staff groups.

endpoints.purpose: Browse staff users (15 newest by default)
Delete a staff user (not the Owner)
Invite a staff user with a role

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook events cover site, post, page, tag and member changes; no staff-user events are listed.

limitations.text: Integration tokens can only browse and read users; write operations on staff need staff-token or user authentication.
The Admin API and webhooks are not available on the Starter plan.

fallbacks.notes: No SSO, so no JIT: staff join by email invite and sign in with password plus email 2FA.
